scope: Same three Art238 authored fixtures, each with native painter variants 1 and 2

variants.differenceFromV0: Same 3 m segment and three posts as v0; adds two wooden diagonal braces, with palette 1. Post count is length-dependent in the source and is three for this fixture.
Same 3 m segment and three posts; metal replaces wood and each bay gains two fine crossing ties, with palette 2. No dense mesh is drawn.
Replaces the timber roof by metal; the major seam becomes horizontal and six seams become vertical. The closed outline and bottom entrance mark remain.
Timber roof with one large metal patch, two fasteners and one small lower-right panel; no central ridge. Closed outline and entrance mark unchanged.
Metal outer shell and central metal disc with one short transverse handle and two side fasteners, replacing v0 two bands and single bung; lower-right outlet retained.
Metal inner lid, one diagonal bar and two unequal bung holes replace the v0 horizontal bands and single bung; wooden outer rim and lower-right outlet remain.

limits: Painter variants do not create additional world objects or save IDs.
Metric author dimensions are provenance, not certification of generated bitmap scale.
An existing procedural renderer is not proof of a missing bitmap.
No faction, abomination, new gameplay object, integration or runnerCable retry.
